name: Build Success
description: Build success rate and status breakdown over the selected period.

success-rate.source: SELECT round(countIf(status = 'successful') * 100.0 / count(), 1) AS successRate FROM core_entities_build FINAL WHERE _deleted = 0 AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL if(toUInt32OrZero({days:String}) = 0, 30, toUInt32OrZero({days:String})) DAY FORMAT JSON

by-status.source: SELECT status, count() AS count FROM core_entities_build FINAL WHERE _deleted = 0 AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL if(toUInt32OrZero({days:String}) = 0, 30, toUInt32OrZero({days:String})) DAY GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC FORMAT JSON
